run_supervised_learning_training: run the supervised learning training loop for a Diplomacy strategy model using a TrainTask config
process_batch_forward_pass: process a batch through the model to compute policy and value losses with teacher forcing
validate_model_on_dataset: validate the trained model on a dataset and compute policy loss, value loss, and accuracy metrics
get_datasets_from_config: create train and validation datasets from a TrainTask config with optional all-powers augmentation
calculate_split_accuracy_counts: calculate weighted accuracy counts split by order type, location, season, and year
